request.query: cart-service is returning 5xx errors after a deploy

report.summary: During the 3‑hour window (2026‑09‑23T09:23:16Z to 2026‑09‑23T12:23:16Z), cart‑service exhibited a sudden spike in 5xx errors (15.00pp) and 20 ERROR logs reporting a NullPointerException in PromotionEngine.applyDiscount (v1.5.0).

likely_causes.title: NullPointerException in PromotionEngine.applyDiscount
likely_causes.rationale: The NPE occurs during discount calculation, causing request failures that surface as 5xx responses. The spike in 5xx errors aligns temporally with the NPE logs.

supporting_evidence.detail: 20 ERROR logs: NullPointerException at com.shop.cart.PromotionEngine.applyDiscount (v1.5.0) between 2026‑09‑23T11:59:48Z and 2026‑09‑23T12:18:48Z.
5xx error rate rose to 15.00pp during the same period, diverging from a near‑zero baseline.

next_steps: Verify recent code changes in v1.5.0 affecting PromotionEngine.applyDiscount.
Add null checks or defensive coding around discount calculation to prevent NPE.
Deploy a rollback or hot‑fix to eliminate the NPE.
Monitor http_requests_total for 5xx to confirm resolution.
Update unit tests to cover null scenarios in PromotionEngine.
